sources.title: Former Residence of Hu Xueyan
sources.excerpt: The Former Residence of Hu Xueyan is a nationally protected traditional Chinese mansion and Jiangnan-style garden at No. 18 Yuanbao Street (元宝街18号) in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, the provincial capital of Zhejiang, China. Located just east of the Zhonghe Elevated Road (中河高架) southeast of West Lake, the residence forms part of the city's Qinghefang Historic District.
